hybrid_primary.name: MLS_128_MLKEM768X25519_AES128GCM_SHA256_Ed25519
hybrid_primary.note: X-Wing (ML-KEM-768 + X25519) hybrid KEM; signatures are classical Ed25519

criteria.criterion: prototype authenticated ReInit from the v1 MLS suite to an experimental hybrid-PQ suite preserving ConversationID and GroupControlState, rejecting downgrade, with vectors
criteria.note: Met as an OM-level authenticated migration built on OpenMLS 0.9.0 MlsGroup::reboot, NOT as RFC 9420 ReInit: OpenMLS 0.9.0 does not implement ReInit (quoted below). A signed diagnostic GroupControlTransition moves a 3-member group from 0x0001 to the hybrid X-Wing suite 0x004F with a new MLS group id, unchanged ConversationID and GroupControlState hash, and a monotone security_generation floor that rejects downgrade, equal-generation, replay, stale-parent, unauthorised and tampered transitions. If the gate must be read as the literal RFC 9420 ReInit proposal, record this as partial.

independence: Written by a Claude agent from RFC 9420, ADR-0165/0173 and the public OpenMLS 0.9.0 API. Single-vendor evidence (ADR-0167); not an independent implementation or review.
limitations: Test-provider keys only: OpenMlsRustCrypto with in-memory storage and freshly generated Ed25519 keys. No durable storage, no OM credential type, no key management.
No real network, relay, KeyPackage publication/consumption or Welcome delivery: key packages are handed over in-process and each joiner holds its own provider.

The migration is an OM-level construction on MlsGroup::reboot. It is not an interoperable RFC 9420 ReInit: the new group has no ReInit/resumption PSK link to the old group, and another MLS implementation would see two unrelated groups plus an OM-private GroupContext extension (type 0xFF51).

GroupControlTransition here is a diagnostic stand-in (JSON struct, length-prefixed canonical bytes, Ed25519 signature). It is not CDDL, not deterministic CBOR and not a frozen wire format; ADR-0156 owns the real encoding.

GroupControlState is a stand-in hash over (ConversationID, roster with device keys and roles). The security floor is held beside it, not inside the hash; whether security_generation.group is hashed state is a design decision this prototype does not make (G-V19-4).

The experimental hybrid suite 0x004F is a draft-ietf-mls-pq-ciphersuites provisional code point (X-Wing draft-06 KEM). Its hybrid KEM is PQ-hybrid but its signatures and credentials are classical Ed25519, so authentication is not post-quantum.

Same-author caveat: author, verifier and test harness are one agent and one codebase; every negative vector was designed by the author of the check it exercises. The Authority set is a plain input, not derived from real GroupControlState policy.
Concurrent competing migrations are shown to be order-dependent; no canonical-successor ordering (ADR-0173) is implemented for migration transitions.
past_epoch_window is exercised by advancing the OLD group with extra commits. A real migration stops advancing the old group, so the epoch-count window would never close (G-V19-1).
No performance, size or battery numbers, and no iOS/Android execution; the cross-runtime comparison is macOS arm64 native versus wasm32 under Node/V8 only.
Pre-release criterion (interoperable migration across two implementations) is untouched; no second implementation implements ReInit or reboot-based migration.

native_vs_wasm.wasm: wasm32-unknown-unknown under Node/V8 via wasm-bindgen --target nodejs

reinit_not_implemented.meaning: RFC 9420 ReInit proposal, ReInit resumption PSK binding and branch PSK are unimplemented; reboot creates a fresh group with the same member list and no cryptographic link to the old epoch secrets.

vectors.expectation: classical v1 group with alice, bob, carol: every member reads every other member's message
vectors.name: v1_group_three_members_exchange_messages

vectors.expectation: reboot into the hybrid suite: new MLS group id, all 3 members join, equal exporter secret, mesh messaging works, exporter differs from the old group
vectors.name: migrate_to_hybrid_all_members_join_exporters_match

vectors.expectation: ConversationID and the GroupControlState hash are identical before and after; the new MLS group carries them in its GroupContext binding
vectors.name: conversation_id_and_state_hash_unchanged_across_migration

vectors.expectation: a correctly signed authorised upgrade passes verify_transition on every member; the diagnostic JSON round-trips
vectors.name: valid_transition_accepted_and_serialises

vectors.expectation: after migrating to hybrid (generation 2), an authorised, correctly signed transition back to the classical suite is rejected: Downgrade at its true generation, ProfileGenerationMismatch if it claims a higher generation
vectors.name: downgrade_hybrid_to_classical_rejected

vectors.expectation: at generation 2 on 0x004F, a transition to another generation-2 profile (0x004E, smaller profile id) is rejected as NotAboveFloor; the unregistered ciphersuite 0x0007 is rejected as UnregisteredProfile
vectors.name: equal_generation_lower_profile_rejected

vectors.expectation: a roster member that is not in the migration authority set (bob, plain member) is rejected as Unauthorized even with a valid signature; a signer outside the roster is UnknownAuthor; the author-side API refuses before building anything
vectors.name: unauthorized_author_rejected

vectors.expectation: changing new group id, ciphersuite, generation, state hash, old group id or author after signing yields BadSignature; a signature by another roster key is BadSignature
vectors.name: tampered_fields_fail_signature

vectors.expectation: an admin that correctly signs a transition carrying a different GroupControlState hash is rejected as StateHashMismatch (the migration may not change group authority)
vectors.name: authorised_author_changing_state_hash_rejected

vectors.expectation: (a) a device outside the welcome cannot process it; (b) the author-side filter refuses a non-roster key package; (c) a rogue authorised author that includes a non-roster key package is caught by every honest joiner's staged-welcome roster check and nobody joins
vectors.name: non_roster_member_cannot_join_new_group

vectors.expectation: a joiner refuses a welcome whose MLS group id or ciphersuite differs from the signed transition it was paired with; the matching pairing is accepted; a joiner whose staged welcome was rejected cannot retry with the same key package
vectors.name: joiner_rejects_welcome_not_matching_transition

observed.retry_error: No matching key package was found in the key store.

vectors.expectation: tail message from the last pre-migration epoch, delivered after migration and 0 old-group commit(s), is decryptable (past_epoch_window = 2)
vectors.name: old_group_tail_message_after_0_old_epoch_advances

vectors.expectation: tail message from the last pre-migration epoch, delivered after migration and 1 old-group commit(s), is decryptable (past_epoch_window = 2)
vectors.name: old_group_tail_message_after_1_old_epoch_advances

vectors.expectation: tail message from the last pre-migration epoch, delivered after migration and 2 old-group commit(s), is decryptable (past_epoch_window = 2)
vectors.name: old_group_tail_message_after_2_old_epoch_advances

vectors.expectation: the same tail message after 3 old-group commits (window 2 exceeded) is NOT decryptable
vectors.name: old_group_tail_message_after_3_old_epoch_advances

vectors.expectation: the same tail message after 4 old-group commits (window 2 exceeded) is NOT decryptable
vectors.name: old_group_tail_message_after_4_old_epoch_advances

vectors.expectation: INFORMATIONAL: migration does not retire the old MLS group; after migration the old group still sends, receives and commits (an OM-level seal is required, not provided by reboot)
vectors.name: old_group_stays_live_in_mls_after_migration

vectors.expectation: after applying the migration, the same transition is rejected as AlreadyApplied and applying the floor twice changes nothing
vectors.name: replay_of_applied_transition_rejected_idempotent

vectors.expectation: a validly signed upgrade whose old group/generation is not the current floor (made against a stale view) is rejected as StaleParent
vectors.name: stale_parent_rejected

vectors.expectation: INFORMATIONAL: two admins sign different valid migrations from the same parent; each verifier accepts the one it sees first and rejects the other, so two verifiers with opposite arrival order diverge (verify_transition alone does not converge; ADR-0173 canonical-successor ordering is required)
vectors.name: concurrent_competing_migrations_are_order_dependent
